limitations: Cluster APIs are asynchronous with explicit slot/all-command-keys responsibility. Complete key-command metadata, replica-read policy, refreshed seed selection, synchronous Cluster facade and complete production acceptance remain open.

Shared Nodes is borrowed/retained, never closed by Client. Closed retires client posts/watches/timer and progress-engine pin; pending native FIFO/resources remain independently owned by Nodes. Its owner closes Nodes and joins engines. Keep code loaded through all retained result destruction.

Warm admission copies once into Route; bootstrap adds a temporary input copy and missing-slot retry can overlap two route objects. Parent Future/box/cancel observer, route storage, native Future/wire, references, gates, heap and timer work remain real costs. Caller-retained results leave client quotas and remain caller-owned. No zero-overhead claim.

Request/encoded-command/controller reservations and metadata/native limits are independent. Map refs borrowed during concurrent Call construction can retain prior views until admission finishes. Footprint single combines XRT/product; static/shared primary rows are product-only, with separate core artifacts inventoried by symbol checks.

Performance compares one caller at pipeline1/32 on the identical warmed maintained pool/peer/engine. Direct native knows the exact endpoint and has fewer semantics; it is a lower-bound cost control, not equivalent-feature regression/speedup, Hiredis or full performance acceptance. Caller-observed FIFO completion includes queue/validation and head-of-line delay.

Unpinned serial local closed-loop samples, separate global heap runs and WSL do not establish fixed-arrival/mixed-load/concurrent/native Linux/CPU/RSS/upstream/TLS/72h production acceptance. Per-process first-window allocator/request costs remain in measured loops. Noise and clock qualification are recorded without rerunning for green.

Real Redis tests are owned prewarmed plaintext IPv4/default-user pools; actual slot ownership changes and automatic MOVED refresh are covered. TLS/auth/trust, replica failover and cold-real connection bootstrap remain separate acceptance work.
